Rare-Disease Case Search

Describe a patient's findings. This searches published case reports for patients whose reported features overlap, and shows what those cases turned out to be. It runs entirely in your browser — nothing you type is sent anywhere.

Read this first. A research tool — not a diagnostic device and not medical advice. It ranks published case reports by how much their recorded findings overlap with yours. Records come from automated extraction with known error rates (phenotype F1 0.56), and findings a paper explicitly ruled out are mostly missing, so a finding not listed here never means it was excluded. Read the cited paper, and take anything useful to a clinician.

Open data (CC BY 4.0) extracted from open-access PubMed Central case reports, each assertion carrying a character offset into its source. Method, measured error rates and code: github.com/jamospop/rare-disease-db. Matching weights rare findings far above common ones, so a shared unusual feature counts for much more than a shared common one.
